panels.title: Indicadores del período EN CURSO (parcial: se calcula con SQL sobre las mediciones)
panels.description: Una fila por período abierto. Hora = hora en punto; Turno = T1 06-14, T2 14-22, T3 22-06; Día = 00:00 a 24:00; Semana = lunes a domingo (hora Argentina). El valor cambia hasta que el período cierra.

targets.query:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT 'hora' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'turno' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '8 hours', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T01:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '8 hours', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T01:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dia' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T03:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T03:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'semana' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '7 days', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-05T03:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '7 days', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-05T03:00:00Z')
)
SELECT periodo AS "Período", to_char(inicio - INTERVAL '3 hours', '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') AS "Inicio (hora Argentina)",
  round(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='CAUDAL' AND quality=2 THEN value END)
        / nullif(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='CORRIENTE' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 0), 4) AS "EQ01 Eficiencia energética (m3h/A)",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='ESTADO' AND quality=2 AND value >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='ESTADO' AND quality=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "EQ01 Disponibilidad (%)",
  round((avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_IN' AND quality=2 THEN value END)
         - avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_OUT' AND quality=2 THEN value END))
        / nullif(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_IN' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 0) * 100, 3) AS "EQ02 Eficiencia de filtración (%)",
  round(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='PRES_DIF' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 2) AS "EQ02 Presión diferencial media (mbar)",
  round((CASE periodo WHEN 'hora' THEN 60 WHEN 'turno' THEN 480 WHEN 'dia' THEN 1440 ELSE 10080 END)
        * sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 AND (value < 6.5 OR value > 8.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "EQ03 Tiempo con pH fuera de rango (min)",
  round(stddev(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 4) AS "EQ03 Desvío del pH"
FROM b
GROUP BY periodo, inicio
ORDER BY CASE periodo WHEN 'hora' THEN 1 WHEN 'turno' THEN 2 WHEN 'dia' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT 'hora' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'turno' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '8 hours', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T01:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '8 hours', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T01:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dia' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T03:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01T03:00:00Z')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'semana' AS periodo, date_bin(INTERVAL '7 days', time, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-05T03:00:00Z') AS inicio, equipo, variable, value, quality
  FROM raw_variables WHERE time >= date_bin(INTERVAL '7 days', now(), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-05T03:00:00Z')
)
SELECT periodo AS "Período", to_char(inicio - INTERVAL '3 hours', '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') AS "Inicio (hora Argentina)",
  round(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='CAUDAL' AND quality=2 THEN value END)
        / nullif(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='CORRIENTE' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 0), 4) AS "EQ01 Eficiencia energética (m3h/A)",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='ESTADO' AND quality=2 AND value >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ01' AND variable='ESTADO' AND quality=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "EQ01 Disponibilidad (%)",
  round((avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_IN' AND quality=2 THEN value END)
         - avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_OUT' AND quality=2 THEN value END))
        / nullif(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='TURB_IN' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 0) * 100, 3) AS "EQ02 Eficiencia de filtración (%)",
  round(avg(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ02' AND variable='PRES_DIF' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 2) AS "EQ02 Presión diferencial media (mbar)",
  round((CASE periodo WHEN 'hora' THEN 60 WHEN 'turno' THEN 480 WHEN 'dia' THEN 1440 ELSE 10080 END)
        * sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 AND (value < 6.5 OR value > 8.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "EQ03 Tiempo con pH fuera de rango (min)",
  round(stddev(CASE WHEN equipo='EQ03' AND variable='PH' AND quality=2 THEN value END), 4) AS "EQ03 Desvío del pH"
FROM b
GROUP BY periodo, inicio
ORDER BY CASE periodo WHEN 'hora' THEN 1 WHEN 'turno' THEN 2 WHEN 'dia' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Indicadores del último período CERRADO (los guarda Node-RED al cerrar cada período)
panels.description: Cada período cerrado se guarda una sola vez en la base (measurement kpi_values), con la marca de tiempo del INICIO del período.

targets.query:
WITH ult AS (
  SELECT equipo, kpi, periodo, max(time) AS t FROM kpi_values WHERE cerrado = true GROUP BY equipo, kpi, periodo
)
SELECT k.equipo AS "Equipo", k.kpi AS "Indicador", max(k.unit) AS "Unidad",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='hora' THEN k.value END) AS "Hora",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='turno' THEN k.value END) AS "Turno",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='dia' THEN k.value END) AS "Día",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='semana' THEN k.value END) AS "Semana"
FROM kpi_values k JOIN ult u ON k.equipo=u.equipo AND k.kpi=u.kpi AND k.periodo=u.periodo AND k.time=u.t
WHERE k.cerrado = true
GROUP BY k.equipo, k.kpi
ORDER BY k.equipo, k.kpi
targets.rawSql:
WITH ult AS (
  SELECT equipo, kpi, periodo, max(time) AS t FROM kpi_values WHERE cerrado = true GROUP BY equipo, kpi, periodo
)
SELECT k.equipo AS "Equipo", k.kpi AS "Indicador", max(k.unit) AS "Unidad",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='hora' THEN k.value END) AS "Hora",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='turno' THEN k.value END) AS "Turno",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='dia' THEN k.value END) AS "Día",
  max(CASE WHEN k.periodo='semana' THEN k.value END) AS "Semana"
FROM kpi_values k JOIN ult u ON k.equipo=u.equipo AND k.kpi=u.kpi AND k.periodo=u.periodo AND k.time=u.t
WHERE k.cerrado = true
GROUP BY k.equipo, k.kpi
ORDER BY k.equipo, k.kpi

panels.title: Tendencia de todas las variables (pendiente en el rango elegido)
panels.description: Pendiente de la recta de ajuste (regresión lineal) por hora. Si el cambio relativo es menor al 2 % por hora se considera estable.

targets.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT equipo, variable, count(*) AS n, avg(value) AS media,
         regr_slope(value, date_part('epoch', time)) * 3600 AS pendiente_h
  FROM raw_variables
  WHERE quality = 2 AND variable <> 'ESTADO' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY equipo, variable
)
SELECT equipo AS "Equipo", variable AS "Variable", n AS "Muestras", round(media, 3) AS "Media",
  round(pendiente_h, 4) AS "Pendiente por hora",
  round(100 * pendiente_h / nullif(media, 0), 2) AS "Cambio % por hora",
  CASE WHEN abs(100 * pendiente_h / nullif(media, 0)) < 2 THEN 'estable'
       WHEN pendiente_h > 0 THEN 'ascendente' ELSE 'descendente' END AS "Tendencia"
FROM t
WHERE n >= 10
ORDER BY abs(100 * pendiente_h / nullif(media, 0)) DESC

panels.title: Anomalías: vibración con bandas de ±3 desvíos (ventana de 20 muestras)
panels.description: Cada valor se compara con la media y el desvío de las 20 muestras anteriores. Si se aleja más de 3 desvíos (|z| > 3) se marca como anomalía.

targets.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time, value,
         avg(value) OVER w AS mu, stddev(value) OVER w AS sd, count(value) OVER w AS n
  FROM raw_variables
  WHERE equipo='EQ01' AND variable='VIBRACION' AND quality IN (1,2) AND $__timeFilter(time)
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT time, value AS "Vibración (mm/s)",
  mu AS "Media de la ventana",
  mu + 3 * sd AS "Banda superior (+3σ)",
  mu - 3 * sd AS "Banda inferior (-3σ)",
  CASE WHEN n >= 10 AND sd > 0 AND abs((value - mu) / sd) > 3 THEN value END AS "Anomalía"
FROM s
ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time, value,
         avg(value) OVER w AS mu, stddev(value) OVER w AS sd, count(value) OVER w AS n
  FROM raw_variables
  WHERE equipo='EQ01' AND variable='VIBRACION' AND quality IN (1,2) AND $__timeFilter(time)
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT time, value AS "Vibración (mm/s)",
  mu AS "Media de la ventana",
  mu + 3 * sd AS "Banda superior (+3σ)",
  mu - 3 * sd AS "Banda inferior (-3σ)",
  CASE WHEN n >= 10 AND sd > 0 AND abs((value - mu) / sd) > 3 THEN value END AS "Anomalía"
FROM s
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Correlación entre variables (r de Pearson)
panels.description: r va de -1 a 1. Cerca de 1: suben juntas; cerca de -1: una sube cuando la otra baja; cerca de 0: no hay relación lineal.

targets.query:
WITH b AS (SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN variable='CAUDAL' THEN value END) AS caudal, max(CASE WHEN variable='CORRIENTE' THEN value END) AS corriente, max(CASE WHEN variable='PRESION' THEN value END) AS presion, max(CASE WHEN variable='VIBRACION' THEN value END) AS vibracion FROM raw_variables WHERE equipo='EQ01' AND quality IN (1,2) AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time),
f AS (SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN variable='TURB_IN' THEN value END) AS turb_in, max(CASE WHEN variable='TURB_OUT' THEN value END) AS turb_out, max(CASE WHEN variable='PRES_DIF' THEN value END) AS pres_dif, max(CASE WHEN variable='EFICIENCIA' THEN value END) AS eficiencia FROM raw_variables WHERE equipo='EQ02' AND quality IN (1,2) AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time),
r AS (SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN variable='PH' THEN value END) AS ph, max(CASE WHEN variable='OD' THEN value END) AS od, max(CASE WHEN variable='TEMP' THEN value END) AS temp FROM raw_variables WHERE equipo='EQ03' AND quality IN (1,2) AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time),
c AS (
SELECT 'EQ01' AS equipo, 'Caudal vs Corriente' AS par, corr(caudal, corriente) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ01' AS equipo, 'Caudal vs Vibración' AS par, corr(caudal, vibracion) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ01' AS equipo, 'Vibración vs Corriente' AS par, corr(vibracion, corriente) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ01' AS equipo, 'Caudal vs Presión' AS par, corr(caudal, presion) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ02' AS equipo, 'Turbidez entrada vs salida' AS par, corr(turb_in, turb_out) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM f
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ02' AS equipo, 'Presión diferencial vs Eficiencia' AS par, corr(pres_dif, eficiencia) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM f
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ03' AS equipo, 'pH vs Oxígeno disuelto' AS par, corr(ph, od) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EQ03' AS equipo, 'Temperatura vs Oxígeno disuelto' AS par, corr(temp, od) AS r, count(*) AS n FROM r
)
SELECT equipo AS "Equipo", par AS "Par de variables", round(r, 3) AS "Correlación (r)", n AS "Muestras",
  CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN 'sin datos'
       WHEN abs(r) >= 0.7 THEN 'fuerte' WHEN abs(r) >= 0.4 THEN 'moderada' ELSE 'débil o nula' END AS "Intensidad",
  CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN '' WHEN r > 0 THEN 'positiva (suben juntas)' ELSE 'negativa (una sube, la otra baja)' END AS "Sentido"
FROM c
ORDER BY equipo, par
